bodyTextSnippet:
Engage other Ministries Departments and Agencies on 1Gov
Welcome to the
Paperless Civil Service Portal
GOVTEST

Fast. Transparent. Easy to Use

Our Ministry has transitioned to a fully paperless process, making it easier for you to access services, submit requests, and track progress anytime, anywhere, without visiting our offices.

Steps To Engage Us
1

Choose a service from the menu

2

Fill out the form and attach required documents

3

Submit online - no queues, no paper

4

Receive a reference number for tracking

5

Get notified when your request is processed

What You Can Do Here
Engage Us
Through this portal, you can reach us to request a service, make enquiries, submit complaint, make suggestions or simply commend us. We will ensure your engagement gets the attention it deserves.
Engage Us
Track Engagement
Anytime you engage us, we will send u a Tracking ID as reference for your engagement. You can engage us on the matter anytime using your email address and Tracking ID.
Track Engagement
Verify Staff
Is anyone claiming to be a staff of Govtest? Confirm the authenticity of our staff by validating their credentials using their Surname and Staff ID.
Verify Staff
Your Information Is Secure

This portal uses modern security controls to protect your personal information. To ensure you are on the official website, please check for the following before submitting your details:

✔
Look for the padlock 🔒 icon in your browser's address bar
✔
Ensure the website address starts with https://
✔
Confirm the domain name matches the Ministry's official government domain
✔
Avoid using links shared through unofficial social media accounts or unknown sources

If in doubt, type the Ministry's website address directly into your browser.
Your data is processed strictly for the purpose of the service you request. We do not share your information with unauthorized third parties.

Need Help? Watch this video to see how it works

A Simpler Public Service Starts Here. We remain committed to providing a modern, responsive, and citizen-focused digital experience. Thank you for embracing our paperless transformation.

, Babatunde Layout, Olorunlogbon Qtrs. Plot 7, Block 3 Plot 7, Block 3, Babatunde Layout Oyo, Nigeria
